append.detail: 2026-11-19 (LIVE-2445): Under ADR-1978 (owner 2026-11-18/19: "Free spaces cannot sell.") and the owner's approval to rewrite pinned probes for this rollout ("Yes, all groups in the doc"), PLAN_STORY now says "A free Space sells nothing", which the old pattern read as the claim it forbids.
